title: 能: can (able to), vs 会 and 可以
summary: Lets you say you are able to do something and choose between 能, 会 and 可以.
explanation:
There are three words for 'can'. 会 = a learned skill (我会游泳 'I can swim'). 能 = being able, given the situation or your abilities (我今天不能去 'I can't go today', 他能吃很多 'He can eat a lot'). 可以 = permission (这里可以坐吗？).

能 and 可以 overlap in requests: 你能帮我吗？ and 你可以帮我吗？ both mean 'Can you help me?' For 'not allowed', 不能 is also common: 这儿不能吃东西.

examples.en: He can eat three bowls of rice by himself.

examples.zh: 我会游泳，但是今天不能游。
examples.en: I can swim, but I can't swim today.
You can't make phone calls here.

mistakes.wrong: 我能说汉语，我学了两年。
mistakes.right: 我会说汉语，我学了两年。

mistakes.why: Use 不能 for not being able to, and time comes before the verb.

exercises.en: I'm ill; I can't go to school today.
why: Correct: 不能 = not able, because of the situation.
不会 means you don't know how to go.
能 is about ability in a situation; for a learned skill use 会.
Don't stack 吗 and 吧; and 会 here would mean 'will you'.
没能 is 'wasn't able to (in the past)'.
能不吃 means 'can do without eating'.

exercises.why: Time before 能, and 能 before the verb.

exercises.prompt: Which word fits? 'May I sit here?' 我___坐这儿吗？
why: Correct: asking permission = 可以 (能 is also heard).
能不 makes no sense here.
